name: Niigata (Japan)
description: An olive-green field charged at the centre with the Niigata city emblem in white: a broken ring enclosing a stylised mark incorporating an anchor, evoking the city's port.

features.role: Niigata city emblem — a ring enclosing an anchor motif
features.symbolism: the anchor recalls Niigata's history as a major Sea of Japan port
